state.acceptanceRules: Evaluate aggregate boundary design, not whether a command route or test is complete. One owner per independently changing identity/lifecycle unless a named invariant requires atomic shared state. Keep cross-owner decisions in handlers using exact proofs; never rely on projections as authority. Avoid unbounded unrelated history or invented lifetime caps. A split is sound only when its coordinator/reservations preserve the invariant and have durable retry/recovery.

rows.name: SystemBoundary
rows.invariant: A boundary has one current draft; approval requires latest accepted review of exact draft revision, an independent/waived actor and strictly increasing approved effective date; exact-scope responsibility changes cannot create retroactive unwaived decision conflict.
rows.splitTest: Retain the complete conflict-relevant responsibility/decision state for the current exact boundary draft scope in the same authoritative decision boundary as its review and approval. Do not turn current assignments into independent unconstrained aggregate streams. Narrow accumulated past-scope/version histories and external waiver behavior; a physical draft/publication split is a conditional future design, not the present audit verdict. The collection protects an actual atomic rule over its members: one member cannot hold overlapping work and review/approval responsibilities for the same exact version/revision without an accepted exact waiver, and a later backdated assignment cannot invalidate a prior unwaived review/approval decision. This falls under rule4. Record identity alone does not justify separating assignments.

Create compares initial content even after revisions. Review DecisionId=RequestId but no duplicate/change check; revision/approval retries fail after success. Expected physical append OCC.

No invented lifetime cap. Both memory and replay grow unbounded across revisions, successor approvals, assignments and duplicate reviews.

Create/revise/review/publish/retire retry checks include newly generated server timestamps. Pinned Portia uses full physical stream replay and expected physical position; no durable request dedup is supplied.
rows.stateAndGrowth: Every version with entire record contents/review/approval and growing accepted contribution references retained and copied into every event; MaximumVersions64 prohibits further normal editing. Nominal256KiB bound is ineffective per CORE-01.
rows.contention: All versions and current template retirement/publication share one revision; old published versions are immutable and do not need contention.
rows.events: Authorship/review/publish/retire facts are domain decisions; no event on denied self-review. Full State copies historical facts. Emit holds statically DomainEvent then serializes it, triggering CORE-01. Truncated rules16/18/21 await clarification; explicit business actor/signer snapshots were not automatically treated as equivalent to metadata.Actor.
rows.crossOwner: Accepts contribution ShareView value proof, not live owner; no direct reads. Validates applicability of exact digest/provenance while contributor review/acceptance is separately owned.
rows.decisionStatus: provisional scope recommendation; concrete protocol and final exact-head review required before implementation

rows.name: MethodologyTemplateContribution
rows.invariant: Only immutable proposed deidentified record that receives independent approved review then acceptance by a third platform operator becomes shareable; tenant/source lineage stays in tenant-owned stream.
rows.splitTest: These three irreversible decisions jointly authorize sharing one content capsule; separating author/review/acceptance without exact value/version gate would leak unapproved content. No retained child roster.
rows.identity: Tenant / methodology-template-contributions / contributionId; one immutable proposal; current review/acceptance immutable. Exact retries compare server generated ProposedAt/ReviewedAt/AcceptedAt and proposal only replays at revision1. Pinned Portia uses full physical stream replay and expected physical position; no durable request dedup is supplied.
rows.stateAndGrowth: Exactly one proposed record, one review, one acceptance; lifetime at most3 facts. Fixed payload references max50, not an unbounded child history. Nominal128KiB guard measures base DomainEvent (CORE-01).
rows.contention: One contribution decision only; independent contributions do not share revision.
rows.events: Proposed content, accepted decline/approve review and platform acceptance are business facts. Decline establishes review outcome, not event for a rejected command. Full view duplicates fixed source facts. Truncated rules16/18/21 await clarification; explicit business actor/signer snapshots were not automatically treated as equivalent to metadata.Actor.
rows.crossOwner: No live aggregate parameters or reads; ShareableContent produces deidentified value capsule. Review remains human accepted judgment; UUID literal check alone is not claimed complete semantic deidentification.
rows.decisionStatus: retained boundary; implementation findings remain

rows.name: TemplateApplication
rows.invariant: One application pins exact published template provenance, fixed planned tenant draft identities and completion state; one pending later-version adoption proposal receives one immutable disposition before next successor.
rows.splitTest: All-drafts-created is technical orchestration; each draft has own lifecycle in its real owner and needs no lifetime copy in parent domain state. Pending successor/version ordering requires compact admission owner if decisions split.
rows.identity: Tenant / template-applications / UUIDv5(programId, templateId+trimmed ApplicationKey); per-entry planned UUIDv5(applicationId,entryKey). Same application/proposal/disposition compares generated timestamps; drafts have stable exact receipt comparison. Pinned Portia uses full physical stream replay and expected physical position; no durable request dedup is supplied.
rows.stateAndGrowth: Full source version with all content, fixed draft receipts and every successor version/proposal/decision retained and copied into every event. MaximumSuccessorDecisions64 forbids later valid successor. Nominal256KiB guard ineffective per CORE-01.
rows.contention: Downstream draft receipts and independent successor adoption decisions share revision.
rows.events: Methodology application/adoption/disposition are business choices; TemplateApplicationDraftCreated explicitly records downstream owner creation receipt, a technical saga step. Full State copies all histories. Truncated rules16/18/21 await clarification; explicit business actor/signer snapshots were not automatically treated as equivalent to metadata.Actor.
rows.crossOwner: Published version VIEW is value proof; handler hydrates template/program admission. No live aggregate read. Current tree has no runtime RecordDraftCreated caller/reactor beyond method and tests; do not claim downstream execution is delivered.
rows.decisionStatus: provisional scope recommendation; concrete protocol and final exact-head review required before implementation

rows.name: ControlOperationsLedger
rows.invariant: One control operating-plan line has independently approved non-overlapping effective versions; one occurrence can be attested/corrected and independently reviewed against its exact frozen plan and evidence requirements. Plan approval reassigns every open/returned occurrence to the approved owner.
rows.splitTest: Different controls and occurrences do not need one program stream. However a naive plan/occurrence split would lose atomic owner reassignment of open work. Use a per-control plan admission generation and recoverable canonical occurrence reassignment process, or keep only the small necessary ownership coordination; each occurrence owns its own attestation lifecycle.
rows.identity: tenant/control-operations/programId; planVersionId uses request identity, recurring occurrenceId derives control+periodStart, ad hoc occurrenceId uses request identity. Per-line and per-occurrence logical revisions share program physical OCC. Several retry paths only check ID/proposer; review identity ignores changed content.

stateAndGrowth.retained: Every control plan version, every materialized occurrence and all attestation/review/reassignment histories.
stateAndGrowth.lifetimeReplay: Recurring work grows with time without bound; every correction adds full attestation evidence and expected-evidence content. Per-command evidence/text limits do not bound program replay.

rows.contention: All control plans and occurrence work contend on one physical append position; client logical revisions mask that shared conflict domain.
rows.events: Plans, attestations, review outcomes and reassignments are business facts. Expected virtual occurrence lists are projection concerns. No negative validation receipts. Plan approval includes all open reassignments in one potentially large event.
rows.crossOwner: ControlVersionView and versionUntil are values supplied from control owner at admission. Plan/occurrence review gets live waiver and calls Allows.
rows.decisionStatus: provisional scope recommendation; concrete protocol and final exact-head review required before implementation
